title: Need help making my ruins a dark room with light around player mz

posts.author: spades141
posts.body: So i have a cave/ruins like map that is gonna be spooky kinda. and i want the play to be dark with a light around them. I know there are plugins but im not really sure how to use them bc this is my first game. but i saw someone say make a img with white circle in the middle and to do some variable switchs. im new to variable switchs but this is what i have. idk if its right and how to make the event? do i just have control switch to isdarkcave bc thats suppposed to trigger it. also idk the size of the circle dark back ground should be. here are a few photos of what i have.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Not sure what you want the variables for. If you're not using plugins, your player will always be on the center of the screen, so just display your circle like that and make sure that the border of the map has enough buffer space so the player never leaves the center of the screen.
In terms of the eventing itself you can simply display the circle like so at the entrance to your cave:
Fadeout>Show picture circle>Transfer player to cave>Fadein.
And you do the same thing on each exit out of the cave, except the you erase it.

posts.body:
spades141 said:
Click to expand...
Yeah, as you can see in the video, the map is smaller than the window size which is why the circle has to follow the character due to them not centering on the screen.
In that case you'll need variables and constantly check the player location for the circle to move. But I find just accommodating the circle by having a buffer zone around the map is much more efficient and less lag-prone as well as being much easier to event.
again, nice that you got it working. Good luck with ya game.
